comment: The airdress-cli revision every server build uses: the tag AND the commit it must resolve to, so a moved tag stops the build instead of changing what ships. Read by server-build.yml (release and the reproducibility check alike). v0.1.0 is the first tag of airdress-cli's collapsed history (2026-10-07); every earlier tag is gone from that repository, so an older pin cannot be fetched. On 2026-10-08 that history was rewritten to conventional commits with identical trees, so v0.1.0 now names f5eed7e; the source it builds is byte for byte the same.
